steps.label: up
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && : > up5.res; for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -f up/up5.txt ] && break; sleep 10; done; while read f t u; do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X PUT -H "Content-Type: $t" -H 'If-None-Match: *' -T "$f" "$u"); echo "$f $c" >> up5.res; done < up/up5.txt; echo fertig >> up5.res; cat up5.res
